visualCharacteristics.purpose: Side-by-side product comparison cards for account offers
visualCharacteristics.layout: Equal-height outlined text cards; tinted header (title, eyebrow, intro, primary CTA) above a body whose feature lines are rule-separated. Horizontal scroll-snap carousel below 900px, grid above
visualCharacteristics.notes: Header/body split is the first <hr> in the cell if authored, otherwise right after the first link-only paragraph (the CTA). Body paragraphs after the next link-only paragraph get a rule each.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, one text cell: H3 title, eyebrow, intro, CTA link, fee, Learn more link, feature paragraphs. An optional picture-only cell adds a card image
rows: H3 title, eyebrow, intro, CTA, fee, Learn more, features

usage.description: Product comparison of two to four accounts, each with a CTA and a feature list.

reuseGuidance: Use for text-first product/plan comparison cards. For image-led cards use the base cards block.
